title: Cloud SCM Functional-Order Management
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking experienced **Oracle Cloud SCM Functional Consultants specializing in Order Management (OM)** to join our Oracle Practice. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Oracle Cloud SCM implementations, with a focus on Order Management processes, solution design, configuration, and support.


* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Order Management processes.
* Configure and implement **Oracle Cloud Order Management (OM)** solutions.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis sessions and recommend best\-practice solutions.
* Configure order orchestration, fulfillment flows, pricing, shipping, and return management processes.
* Collaborate with business users, solution architects, and technical teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Support functional testing, SIT, UAT, production deployment, and hypercare activities.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, and training materials.
* Work closely with integration teams for SCM, ERP, Logistics, and third\-party system integrations.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and resolve business\-critical issues.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Oracle Cloud Order Management (OM)**.
* Experience in: Order Capture \& Processing, Order Promising, Order Fulfilment, Return Management, Back\-to\-Back Orders, Drop Ship Orders, Internal Material Transfers, Order Orchestration, Pricing Administration, Shipping Execution
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain and Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) processes.
* Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and support activities.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
**What you'll love about working with us**
------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.
